resources.string: Check usage access, the garden keeper, uninstall protection and notifications.

• Tightening a limit applies straight away.
• Loosening or removing one, or turning off strict mode, needs a Bumblebee's yes.
• You can add or remove Bumblebees any time. Only the Bumblebee affected is told.
• When an app's time is up, it rests until tomorrow, unless a Bumblebee gives you extra time.
• In a real emergency, you can lift limits yourself for up to an hour, a few times a month. Your Bumblebees are told.
• If a protection is turned off or your phone goes quiet, your Bumblebees are told.
• Limits keep working on this phone even offline or signed out.
Choose what your Bumblebees can see. They can see these choices, too.
Your total and top apps for today. Your history never leaves this phone.
Tell them when a protection is off
Lets your Bumblebees know if the garden keeper, usage access or uninstall protection is turned off.
Looks at Meadow\'s releases on GitHub over Wi-Fi and lets you know. Nothing installs without your OK.
Android needs your OK for Meadow to install updates. Allow it, then come back and tap Update.
Your data and the small print

This removes your profile, limits, requests, chats and photo from Meadow for good, and signs you out on this phone. The people you look after, and your Bumblebees, will see you\'ve left. It can\'t be undone.
Your limits keep working on this phone while you\'re signed out, but you won\'t be able to ask for extra time.
Your garden has no email yet, so signing out would lose it for good. Add an email first.
